items.title: Researchers modelling the long-term effects of engineered aerosol warming on Mars found that every 20 degrees of global warming increased atmospheric water vapour tenfold in their simulation. The resulting clouds warmed low-latitude nights by up to 10 degrees but cooled daytime temperatures across the winter midlatitudes by as much as 40 degrees—an unintended consequence omitted from earlier dry-atmosphere models.
